name: The Key to Freedom
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The small brass key looks simple enough.. The only thing that seems to make it stand out are some words scratched into the head of it:

"Dark Iron Outhouse - Do Not Duplicate."

You have no idea what it means or what it will lead to.
narrative.objectives: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well, I'll be! How in tarnation!? You found the key! I knew them blasted Dark Irons were hiding it after they locked me in here! Thank ya so much, adventurer. You're the greatest! Now, just turn the key and let ol' Locheed outta here!
narrative.requestItemsText:
*cough*

Who is it? Can't ya see I'm busy?
